remarks.message: Knees caving inward at the bottom of the squat. Focus on pushing knees out in line with your toes.
Good neutral spine maintained throughout the descent.
Squat depth is slightly above parallel. Try to reach just below parallel for full muscle engagement.

tips: Strengthen your hip abductors to prevent knee cave.
Use a slightly wider stance to make reaching parallel more comfortable.
Consider box squats to practice hitting consistent depth.
